dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies, federal contractors, technology developers, and organizations deploying artificial intelligence agents.
dimensions.evidence: Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council shall propose revisions to the Federal Acquisition Regulation to require contractors and Federal agencies procuring or deploying... AI agents... to comply with such standards

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new technical, inventory, discovery, logging, and security requirements on organizations utilizing AI agents and federal contractors.
dimensions.evidence: maintain a continuous, machine-readable inventory of all AI agents... implement AI agent identity verification mechanisms that are cryptographically verifiable

dimensions.assessment: Directs agencies and NIST to develop standards and conduct demonstration projects, but does not explicitly appropriate a specific overall funding sum.
Establishes comprehensive federal guidelines, interagency coordination mandates, and mandatory federal procurement contract revisions concerning AI systems.
dimensions.evidence: To provide for certain artificial intelligence agent discovery and security standards, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing annual standard reviews, recurring procurement updates, and permanent agency guidance requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act and annually thereafter, the Director... shall develop, publish, and maintain standards

missing_information: Specific cost estimates for agencies and contractors to implement the AI discovery and logging standards are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs NIST and other agencies to establish technical and security standards for artificial intelligence agents and mandates federal procurement requirement revisions, affecting technology developers, federal contractors, and federal agencies.
